Fargo property tax is billed by the offices named below.

Who bills what in Fargo

  • City of Fargo Assessment Department handles assessment.
  • Cass County bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

North Dakota statewide (State Tax Commissioner page): real property tax is due January 1 following the year of assessment and payable without penalty until March 1; a 5% discount applies to taxes paid in full by February 15. Cass County page adds: first half due March 1, second half due October 15 (specials and drains in the first installment). Fargo residential tax page states valuations are certified to Cass County Government, which levies and collects the tax.. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Informal review by calling Fargo Assessment (701-241-1340) any time before values are certified; City Board of Equalization meets within the first 15 days of April; County Board of Equalization within the first 10 days of June; State Board of Equalization second Tuesday of August (must have appeared at both city and county boards to go to the state). Formal appeal by abatement: file by November 1 of the year following the year the tax becomes delinquent. Fargo page: may appear at County BOE with. See the official page.

Tax rate

We could not confirm the current Fargo rate on an opened page, so we do not state one.

Local notes

  • Assessed value is 50% of true and full value; taxable value is 9% of assessed for residential and 10% for other property (Cass County assessor page).
  • Census Vintage 2025 population from sub-est2025_38.csv via Firecrawl Alexandria census-gov provider; county from SUMLEV 157 row.

Fargo by the numbers

Fargo has roughly 129,064 residents in the Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey, and ranks number 1 by population among the 7 nd places in this guide. Owner-occupied homes have a median value of $269,800 here, which is 3% above the middle figure for the 7 nd places. About 56% of households rent, so 44% own; the nd median for these places is 58% owner-occupied. Homes here were typically built in 1991, so the median house is about 32 years old. These numbers describe Fargo as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
